summary:
Verified the two final corrections to the floating rich-text toolbar in FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx. (1) ALIGNMENT is now a pure block-level property — tapping L/C/R mutates ONLY the single caret-block (collapsed) or every spanned block (selection). It NEVER manufactures a new paragraph/
. Tapping the same alignment removes it. (2) HIGHLIGHTER is a true ON/OFF toggle — inactive tap opens the color palette, ACTIVE tap turns highlighting off at the caret WITHOUT opening the palette and WITHOUT removing any existing highlighted text in the document. 14/14 acceptance scenarios PASS, zero console errors.

H5_committed_toggle_off.note: Existing world remains intact; exit-anchor ZWSP injected after span; active ring turned off.

H5b_type_lands_outside_highlight.note: Typing 'Z' after toggling off produced plain text immediately after the highlighted span.

critical_code_review_comments: FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx is now ~4000 lines — strongly recommend extracting AlignPanel, HighlightPanel, AaPanel, and the applyAlign/toggleHighlightOff utilities into dedicated files.
ALIGN_CLASSES is still duplicated between applyAlign/readActiveAlign and the AlignPanel ALIGN_OPTIONS table — single source of truth would reduce drift risk.

No automated jest/vitest unit tests cover applyAlign or toggleHighlightOff despite three bug-fix iterations touching them. A small test harness around these pure DOM functions would prevent future regressions.

toggleHighlightOff leaves a ZWSP exit-anchor node (​) in the DOM for committed highlights until the user types past it. The cleanupPendingInlineMarkers walker handles pending markers but not these raw exit anchors — ensure they are stripped on save/export so copy-paste out of the app does not include invisible chars.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
Both fixes verified holistically on Format editor (fullscreen-content-input-format). applyAlign: collapsed-caret path acts on a single block; selection path acts on every spanned block; same-class tap removes the class; NO
/new block is ever injected. toggleHighlightOff: for ZWSP-only pending markers, strips ir-hl-* and ir-pending-inline in place; for committed highlights (real text), span stays, caret moves to a ZWSP exit-anchor sibling just after the span, and new typing is unhighlighted. Highlighter button onClick checks readActiveHighlight(ed) first and short-circuits to toggleHighlightOff without opening the palette. Overlay dismissal note: both the align-panel and hl-panel use data-testid='floating-rte-align-overlay' / 'floating-rte-hl-overlay' click-outside layers; test scripts must click/dispatch on these overlays to dismiss before clicking the next toolbar button, otherwise Playwright reports pointer-interception failures.
